meta.name: teach
meta.description: Teach the user a new skill or concept, within this workspace.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在对话中学习新技能或概念
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想在工作区中快速学习新东西
copy.tagline_en: Learn new skills or concepts through conversation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to quickly learn something new within your workspace

howto.what: Claude 会创建一个教学目录，包含任务说明、参考资料、学习记录、课程文件等，并基于你的学习目标逐步授课。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 教你某个技能或概念时触发，例如说“教我学Python”或“我想了解机器学习”。

say.text: 教我如何用Python写一个简单的网页爬虫。
say.note: Claude 会创建教学目录并开始第一课。

say.text: 我想学习瑜伽的基础体式，帮我制定学习计划。
say.note: Claude 会询问你的学习动机，然后生成课程。

howto.what_en: Claude creates a teaching workspace with mission, references, learning records, and lessons, then teaches step by step based on your goal.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to teach you a skill or concept, e.g., 'Teach me Python' or 'I want to learn machine learning'.

say_en.text: Teach me how to write a simple web scraper in Python.
say_en.note: Claude will create the workspace and start the first lesson.

say_en.text: I want to learn basic yoga poses, help me make a study plan.
say_en.note: Claude will ask about your motivation and generate lessons.
